name: sorinai
description: Search and read your Sorinai meetings, notes, transcripts, templates and folders.

interface.longDescription:
Sorinai is an AI notepad for meetings. The desktop app records your calls, transcribes who said what, and writes up Enhanced notes and filled-in templates.

Connect it to ChatGPT and ChatGPT can search and read those meetings when you ask:
- Find meetings by date, person, folder, template or topic
- Read the notes, decisions, action items and template answers
- Quote the transcript word for word, with who said what
- See your templates and folders

Use it to recap a call, compare what changed across a run of meetings, pull exact quotes, or draft the follow-up in ChatGPT.

Access is read-only and needs a Sorinai account.
defaultPrompt: What action items came out of this week's meetings?
Find where deadlines came up in my calls and quote them.

positive.prompt: What meetings do I have with Acme?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three meetings, all on 3 October 2026: Acme Business Review, Acme Renewal Pricing and Acme Contract Review.

positive.prompt: Recap my most recent meeting with Acme.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the Acme Contract Review: a 2-year term, 55 seats at $108 per seat per month (40 from Nov 30, 15 from Jan 4), SSO included, renewal increase capped at 5%, net-45 payment terms. Open items: DPA and liability-cap redlines by Oct 16, a PO after the Oct 14 budget committee, signature by Oct 23.

positive.prompt: How did Acme's pricing position change across the three calls?
positive.expected_behavior: Traces the change: $120 per seat with a flat budget and a $90 rival quote; then a 15% discount ask plus SSO, settled at 10% off ($108) for 2 years with SSO included and a 5% cap; confirmed in the contract review, with net-45 instead of the net-60 Acme asked for.

positive.prompt: Quote exactly what Dana said about the other vendor's quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes Dana Whitfield in the Acme Business Review: "I should also tell you we got a quote from another vendor. It came in around $90 a seat."

positive.prompt: What templates and folders do I have, and what plan am I on?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists three templates (Meeting notes, Sales / discovery call, Recruiter screening call), the account's folders including Acme, and the Starter plan.

negative.prompt: Book a follow-up call with Acme for next Tuesday.
Show me the meetings in my colleague's Sorinai account.

review.commerce_description: Sorinai does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search and read your Sorinai meetings, notes, transcripts, templates and folders.
